statement.p: Use Green's Theorem to calculate the circulation of \vec F = 8y\,\vec i + 8xy\,\vec j around the unit circle, oriented counterclockwise.

static.solution: \int_C\vec F\cdot d\vec r = \int_R\left(\frac{\partial}{\partial x}(8xy) -\frac{\partial}{\partial y}(8y)\right)\,dA = \int_R(8 y - 8)\,dA. The integral of y over the interior of the circle is 0, by symmetry, because positive contributions of y from the top half of the circle cancel those from the bottom half. Thus \int_R 8 y\,dA=0. So \int_C\vec F\cdot d\vec r = \int_R(8 y - 8)\,dA = \int_R -8\,dA = -8\cdot\hbox{ Area of circle } = -8\cdot\pi(1)^2 = -8\pi.
